capabilities: Move fully completed top-level task blocks below active content
Keep nested task blocks together with their parent task
Insert newly moved tasks before an existing completed-task tail
Preserve line endings, trailing blank lines, and non-task text
extras: The README recommends keeping file recovery, Sync version history, or Git available when using it on important notes, since the plugin edits editor content directly.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically move completed tasks to the bottom of a note so active tasks stay easy to scan.
summary: Task-list organizer that moves completed top-level Markdown task blocks below active tasks in the current note via a command.
